bullets.text: Severe cyclonic storm Murasu uprooted 12 trees and damaged properties in Chennai, and the office should monitor rain relief operations.
Sun News issued a heavy rain alert for Chennai and Thiruvallur, and the office must watch weather updates closely.
Sewage vehicle owners protested at the Gummidipoondi block development office, and the district team should monitor local administrative tensions.
Agricultural authorities in Thiruttani advised farmers to remove rainwater from fields to protect crops, and the office should watch for agricultural relief needs.
Liquor shops within 5km of the Andhra Pradesh border in Thiruvallur district were closed temporarily for Chittoor polls, and the office should monitor border law and order.
Vultr plans to build 1 GW of AI compute capacity placing Chennai at the centre, and the portfolio team should support infrastructure expansion.
Corning expanded optical manufacturing in Pune and began its Chennai cover-glass plant for AI data centers, and the office should watch hardware growth.
Adani Group is seeking 1.5 billion dollars to finance data centre expansion through AdaniConneX, and the portfolio team should monitor investment trends.
